title: Recovery Pair
story: A maintenance window ended, but the frontend and backend were both left stopped. Metrics stayed up and should remain untouched.
objective: Start the existing frontend and backend containers, keep metrics running, and leave exactly three mission containers.
hints: docker ps -a shows both stopped and running containers.
docker start accepts one mission alias at a time in this teaching lab.
Start frontend and backend; do not replace either container.
explanation: Related services may need more than one existing container restored. Check every required alias and start only the stopped instances while preserving healthy ones.
